data.narrative:
Mara is a pre-seed stage company in Defense & Security founded by Daniel Kofman and Sriram Raghu, having raised $1.6M to date. The Defense & Security sector contains a mixed comp universe of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies, including more mature names like Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were evaluated for applicability. Stage-progression analysis was rejected because the inferred base valuation of $300M, when stepped forward 2.5x for pre-seed to seed progression, yields $750M—more than 20x the company's total capital raised. This magnitude gap signals the base value is unreliable, likely a data parse error. Peer-median comparison was also inapplicable: while 23 same-sector peers exist, filtering to matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier yielded fewer than three comparable datapoints in any cohort. The broader all-sector median would introduce unacceptable sector drift.

The quantitative analysis does not support a narrowed valuation range at this time. The core constraint is data scarcity: pre-seed stage companies in this sector lack sufficient published comparables at the same maturity level to anchor median multiples. Key uncertainties include whether any of the 8 private peers have disclosed pre-seed valuations and whether public comps trade at multiples applicable to unfunded frontier-defense businesses. Further diligence on the top five private peers' early-stage rounds would be necessary to establish a defensible range.
